body:
![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

The critical input files `visualInventory`, `candidates`, `rightsOverlay`, and `receiptRefs` are loaded but their shapes and individual entries are never validated. This violates the repository rules requiring that parsed file shapes are validated, malformed entry diagnostics are recorded, bad entries are skipped, and diagnostics are passed into the package validator to ensure it fails closed.

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. When loading parsed files (such as JSON), validate the parsed file shape, record malformed entry diagnostics, skip bad entries, and pass those diagnostics into the package validator to ensure it fails closed.
2. When reading input collections, validate that key fields are non-empty and exist in the supported registry, skip invalid entries, and return structured diagnostics that flow into the package validator.
</details>

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The unit tests currently only test missing source map files, but do not cover malformed-input guard paths or failure paths for other critical input files such as `visualInventory` or `candidates`. Adding tests for these malformed inputs ensures that the validator correctly fails closed as required by the repository rules.

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. Ensure unit tests for package validators cover all defined validator checks and explicitly test malformed-input guard paths and failure paths (e.g., preflight, bulk gate, identity, receipt/blocker, renderability, visual-basis, confidence-upgrade, min-rule, forbidden-wording, and JSON round-trip handling).
</details>
